description: Fetch metadata and one view (posts, questions, about, or contributors) of a Quora Space. Spaces live on subdomains (e.g., https://thestoics.quora.com). Returns space metadata plus the requested section with lazy-loaded scrolling up to the requested limit.

parameters.name: space
parameters.description: Space slug, i.e. the subdomain of the Space URL https://<space>.quora.com. Example: thestoics.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Which view to return: posts (default post stream) | questions (questions asked in the space) | about (full description) | contributors (member list with credentials).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Ordering for the posts section: top (default) | recent. Only affects section=posts; questions has its own default ordering.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum entries for list-like sections (1-100, default 20). Ignored when section=about.
